dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Fatui have plenty of funds, and they're still not paying what they owe?

dialogues.speaker: Omesov
dialogues.text: Crazy, huh? They accused me of leaking their "secrets" — as if Reed Miller's treasure, squirreled away in the Experimental Design Bureau, was ever classified to begin with!

dialogues.speaker: Omesov
dialogues.text: Okay, so maybe I drank a bit too much and it just slipped out, but after that... I heard that a lot of treasure hunters started hatching schemes to get their hands on that treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Omesov
dialogues.text: That led to tons of people trying to break into the heavily guarded Design Bureau, causing the Fatui no end of trouble... Hehe, serves 'em bloody right!
